observations: I opened assets/panels/05-2.png, main-cast.png and page-05.png and looked at them myself. This is a wide shot with a large plain wall in the upper area and the figures in the lower band. Ananya is at the left, the laptop at the centre and Ravi at the right, with the window at the far left.

Ananya matches her sheet: bun, gold stud, white coat over the teal kurta, stethoscope. Her left hand is open toward the laptop and Ravi. Her right fingertip is on the trackpad. Both match the production notes.
The laptop screen faces the reader. It shows a microphone icon, a shield icon, a ticked check box with small tick sparks, a blank bar, and two rounded buttons, one grey and one teal. I found no text.
Ravi smiles and nods with his right hand open in agreement. His left hand, with the wristwatch, rests on his knee. His face matches his sheet, though it is small in this framing.
On page-05.png the two balloons and the AI VOICE CONSENT label sit on the plain upper wall. The balloon tails point to Ananya and to Ravi. No face, hand or the laptop screen is covered.
